message: The other day, I was cooking up a storm when the smoke alarm suddenly decided to join the party. 😅 While waving a dish towel like a madwoman, I texted the family group chat, "Fire drill!" and we all jokingly shared our escape plans and kitchen mishaps. It reminded me how important it is to have a plan, even if it’s just a shared laugh. Do you have a family plan in your group chat?
